_note: Solar quote request form text (build-plan Phase 6). Shown only when data/site.json leads.enabled is true, on the pages listed in leads.pages. Placeholders: {{site.*}}. No typed numbers.
heading: Get solar quotes for this system
intro: Planning a system like this? Send your city and mobile number and {{site.brand}} will pass your request to solar installers we work with in your city, so you can compare quotes. It is free and you are not obliged to buy.

fields.name: Your name
fields.consent: I agree that {{site.brand}} may share these details with solar installers so they can contact me about a quote.

privacy: We keep requests for {{site.leads.retention_days}} days, then delete them, and never sell your number to advertisers.
success: Thank you. Your request has been received. An installer or the {{site.brand}} team will contact you on the number you gave. Before you sign, check any quote against current prices with the solar quote checker.
